crossRefs.note: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Zilpah
people.line: Leah's maidservant; mother of Gad and Asher

translations.web: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
translations.bsb: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her maidservant.
translations.kjv: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
translations.asv: And Laban gave Zilpah his handmaid unto his daughter Leah for a handmaid.
